title: TUM Heilbronn Metro Line Roadmap (2026 - 2028)

formula: Aptitude Assessment: Overall GPA (65%) + Subject Grades (35% with Math 2x, CS 2x, Lang 1x)

stations.name: Class 3 Kickoff
stations.objective: Class 3 Liceum kickoff, school timetable setup & baseline diagnostics.

deliverables.Academics: Set up TM1 school timetable & semester targets.
deliverables.Code: Harness OS activated & unassisted coding rule established.

stations.next_action: Sprint on Pure Syntax deliverables due by end of September.

stations.name: Pure Syntax
stations.objective: Diagnostic benchmarking & pure unassisted algorithmic habit building.

deliverables.Academics: Benchmark diagnostic test in Math Rozszerzona. Target first-month grade average >= 4.75.
deliverables.Code: Zero AI copilot rule activated. Complete 15 foundational LeetCode Easy problems writing pure algorithms by hand (4/15 solved).
deliverables.SIGG: 25. edycja SIGG: Rejestracja drużyny (2-4 osoby) przez nauczyciela-opiekuna na sigg.gpw.pl (okno do 30 października 2026).
deliverables.German: 20 min/day active input (Nicos Weg A2 module). Target: 100 new vocabulary items in Anki.
deliverables.Physical: Weight 68.5 kg, daily protein floor at 140g.

stations.next_action: Solve LeetCode Problem #5 without AI and trace variables by hand.

stations.name: Gra Testowa & Moduły
stations.objective: 25. edycja SIGG: Rejestracja (do 30.10), Gra Testowa na GPWtr@der & moduły edukacyjne.

deliverables.Academics: First major sprawdziany in Math & CS. Maintain grade 5.0 in both.
deliverables.Code: Solve 20 past CKE Matura task 1s (computational thinking/math logic on paper).
deliverables.SIGG: Dokończyć rejestrację zespołu (do 30.10). Gra testowa na platformie GPWtr@der (2–13.11). Zaliczyć moduły e-learningowe i testy wiedzy.

stations.next_action: Sprawdzić rejestrację zespołu i przejść moduły edukacyjne na platformie GPWtr@der.

stations.name: Etap Główny (20k PLN)
stations.objective: Launch 25. edycja SIGG Etap Główny (20 000 PLN capital) & CKE data parsing tasks.

deliverables.Academics: Mid-semester review. All subjects > 4.0, Math and CS locked at 5.0+.
deliverables.SIGG: Start Etapu Głównego (16 listopada 2026 – 12 marca 2027). Kapitał 20 000 zł na akcje WIG20/mWIG40 i ETF-y. Złożyć obowiązkową pierwszą transakcję. Śledzić 4 premie lotne w trakcie etapu.
deliverables.Code: Transition to CKE Matura programming tasks in Python/C++ (file operations, data parsing).

stations.next_action: Złożyć pierwsze zlecenie w Etapie Głównym SIGG (WIG20/mWIG40/ETF) z kapitału 20 000 zł.

stations.name: Semester 1 Lock
stations.objective: Lock in high grades on Sem 1 transcript & audit stock scanner.

deliverables.Academics: Finalize Semester 1 proposed grades. No grade below 4; Math, CS, English at 5 or 6.
deliverables.SIGG: Etap Główny (20 000 zł): Przegląd portfela akcji/ETF przed przerwą świąteczną i okresem niskiej płynności. Polowanie na premię lotną.
deliverables.German: A2 certification test (self-assessment or mock). Begin transition to B1 materials.
deliverables.Code: Audit desktop/polish_stocks_day_trade-main and understand every function without AI explanation.

stations.next_action: Review Semester 1 transcript and ensure all STEM subjects are 5.0+.

stations.name: Etap Główny Midpoint
stations.objective: SIGG Etap Główny portfolio midpoint audit & dynamic programming drills.

deliverables.Academics: Formal Semester 1 grades locked onto official transcript.
deliverables.SIGG: Półmetek Etapu Głównego (trwa do 12 marca). Audyt portfela akcji/ETF, kontrola obsunięcia kapitału (drawdown) i rywalizacja w modułach wiedzy.
deliverables.Code: Solve 10 dynamic programming and recursion problems from previous Matura sheets.

stations.next_action: Zoptymalizować pozycje w portfelu SIGG (akcje i ETF-y) pod kątem dynamiki sektorowej.

stations.name: Winter Intensive
stations.objective: Winter break math acceleration & futures simulation.

deliverables.Academics: Complete 5 full Math Rozszerzona past sheets (CKE 2020-2024).
deliverables.SIGG: Etap Główny w fazie finałowej (do 12 marca). Przygotowanie do rozgrywki na kontraktach terminowych (start 15 marca): symulacja mechaniki dźwigni FW20 i pozycji krótkich.
deliverables.German: B1 grammar foundations (Subjunctive II, passive voice, subordinate clauses).
deliverables.Physical: Weight 71.0 kg; bench/squat/deadlift baseline increase of 5%.

stations.next_action: Solve 5 complete Math R arkusze under timed conditions.

stations.name: Kontrakty Terminowe
stations.objective: Finisz Etapu Głównego (12.03) i rozgrywka na kontraktach terminowych (15-26.03).

deliverables.SIGG: 12 marca: Zakończenie Etapu Głównego. 15–26 marca: Dedykowana rozgrywka na kontraktach terminowych z osobną pulą 10 000 zł. Ścisły risk management i stop-loss na kontraktach FW20.
deliverables.Academics: Q3 school grades checkup. Ensure Polish, History, and Biology stay >= 4.0.
deliverables.Code: Master SQL databases and Access/Excel data processing modules required for Matura Informatyka.

stations.next_action: Obrót kontraktami terminowymi FW20 w dedykowanym etapie (15–26 marca) z puli 10 000 zł.

stations.name: Ranking & Wielki Finał GPW
stations.objective: Oficjalny ranking (12.04) i Wielki Finał w Sali Notowań GPW w Warszawie (22.04).

deliverables.SIGG: 12 kwietnia: Ogłoszenie rankingu oficjalnego. 22 kwietnia: Wielki Finał 25. edycji w Sali Notowań GPW w Warszawie dla 50 najlepszych zespołów w Polsce (pula nagród >200 tys. zł, laptopy MacBook).
deliverables.Academics: End-of-year sprint begins. Target 5.0+ in all core STEM subjects.
deliverables.German: B1 intermediate listening comprehension (DW Langsam gesprochene Nachrichten).

stations.next_action: Udział w Wielkim Finale 25. edycji SIGG w Sali Notowań GPW w Warszawie (22 kwietnia).

stations.name: Trial Matura Audit
stations.objective: Write official 2027 Matura 1 year early under timed exam conditions.

deliverables.Academics: Sit down with 2027 official Matura papers written by 4th-graders. Score yourself under real exam timing (aim for >70% raw score on Math R 1 year early).
deliverables.Physical: Body weight 72.5 kg at 14-15% body fat.

stations.next_action: Score 2027 official CKE Math sheet and identify gap topics.

stations.name: Year 3 Final Report
stations.objective: Milepost 1 for TUM: 3rd Class Liceum Final Transcript (GPA >= 4.8).

deliverables.Academics: Milepost 1 for TUM: 3rd Class Liceum Final Transcript completed with GPA >= 4.8.
deliverables.Code: Complete a standalone, production-ready project for your portfolio without AI-generated scaffolding.
deliverables.Harness: Update portfolio database with SIGG credentials and year-end metrics.

stations.next_action: Verify final 3rd-year certificate grades with school administration.

stations.name: Summer Build
stations.objective: Goethe B1 certification, Math Calculus sprint, and 74kg mass check.

deliverables.German: Target Goethe-Zertifikat B1 exam or verify B1 competence. Start B2 reading.
deliverables.Academics: Math Rozszerzona topical review (Calculus, Stereometry, Combinatorics).
deliverables.Physical: Peak summer check: 73.5-74 kg, 13-14% body fat, 5k run maintained at sub-4:40 pace.

stations.next_action: Register for Goethe B1 examination.

stations.name: Class 4 Kickoff
stations.objective: Official Matura declarations locked & daily timed algorithm speed drills.

deliverables.Academics: Lock in official Matura declarations: Matematyka Podstawowa + Rozszerzona, Informatyka Rozszerzona, Język Angielski Dwujęzyczny / C1.
deliverables.Code: Daily timed Matura algorithm speed-drills (45 min/day).

stations.next_action: Submit official deklaracja maturalna to school director.

stations.name: TUM Portfolio Prep
stations.objective: Draft English Letter of Motivation highlighting SIGG, coding, and startups.

deliverables.TUM Heilbronn: Draft English Letter of Motivation (emphasizing data science projects, SIGG trading algorithms, startup initiatives).

stations.next_action: Complete first draft of TUM Letter of Motivation.

stations.name: Mock Exam Wave 1
stations.objective: School mock exams (Próbne). Targets: Math R >= 80%, CS >= 75%, English >= 90%.

deliverables.Academics: School mock exams (Nowa Era / Operon / CKE). Target scores: Math R >= 80%, Informatyka >= 75%, English Bilingual >= 90%.

stations.next_action: Simulate 3 trial mock exams before school test week.

stations.name: Semester 3 Final Report
stations.objective: Milepost 2 for TUM: First-semester grades of 4th liceum finalized.

deliverables.Academics: Milepost 2 for TUM: First-semester grades of 4th liceum finalized. All semi-annual grades on transcript reflect high distinction.

stations.next_action: Secure official school stamped record of first semester grades.

stations.name: Uni-Assist Setup
stations.objective: Set up uni-assist.de for VPD processing & address weakest 3 math topics.

deliverables.TUM Pipeline: Set up account on uni-assist.de for VPD (Vorprüfungsdokumentation) processing.
deliverables.Academics: Identify weakest 3 math topics from mock results and solve 100 dedicated drill problems.

stations.next_action: Create and verify profile on uni-assist.de.

stations.name: Winter Lock-in
stations.objective: 10 full past-paper simulations under timed conditions. Zero external assistance.

deliverables.Academics: 10 full past-paper simulations under timed conditions. Zero external assistance.
deliverables.German: B2 conversational practice (prepares for potential TUM aptitude assessment interview).

stations.next_action: Complete past CKE papers 2021-2027 in exam hall conditions.

stations.name: Formal Clearance
stations.objective: Order certified sworn translations (German/English) of transcripts.

deliverables.Academics: Final school grades for 4th year locked in.
deliverables.TUM Pipeline: Order sworn certified translations (German or English) of your 3rd and 4th-year semester reports (Halbjahresnoten).

stations.next_action: Engage certified sworn translator for school transcripts.

stations.name: Graduation
stations.objective: Receive Świadectwo Ukończenia Liceum & assemble TUMonline package.

deliverables.Academics: Receive high school graduation diploma (Świadectwo ukończenia liceum ogólnokształcącego).
deliverables.TUMonline: Portal opens May 15. Prepare upload packages (Passport, CV, Motivation Letter, Transcripts).

stations.next_action: Digitize graduation certificate and prepare certified copies.

stations.name: Egzaminy Maturalne
stations.objective: Write official CKE Matura & submit application via TUMonline.

deliverables.Execution: Write official CKE Matura: Matematyka Podstawa & Rozszerzenie, Język Angielski Dwujęzyczny, Informatyka Rozszerzenie.
deliverables.TUM Application: Submit application via TUMonline as soon as the window opens.

stations.next_action: Execute Matura exam days with maximum precision and composure.

stations.name: VPD & Matura Results
stations.objective: Submit graduation certificate to Uni-Assist for expedited VPD generation.

deliverables.TUM Pipeline: Submit graduation certificate and preliminary grades to Uni-Assist for expedited VPD generation.
deliverables.Physical: Transition back to full boxing schedule (3-4x/week) and gym hypertrophy blocks.

stations.next_action: Track Uni-Assist VPD review status daily.

stations.name: TUM Direct Offer
stations.objective: Stage 1 Aptitude score >= 88 pts triggers Direct Admission to TUM Heilbronn!

deliverables.Action: Immediately forward official Matura certificate to Uni-Assist / TUMonline before July 15 deadline.
deliverables.Outcome: Stage 1 Aptitude score >= 88 points triggers Direct Admission without an assessment interview.
deliverables.Station Arrived: Acceptance letter confirmed for B.Sc. Management and Data Science at TUM Campus Heilbronn.

stations.next_action: Accept TUM Heilbronn direct offer and secure Heilbronn student accommodation.
